steps.caption: Domain settings
steps.narration: The exclusion list your Google Ads script downloads is built from three settings. Here's where they are.

steps.caption: How the list is built
steps.narration: The note at the top says how: manual excludes and blocked IPs, minus the whitelist, up to the length you set.

steps.caption: Manually exclude IPs
steps.narration: Manually exclude IPs go first on the list. One IP, CIDR range or wildcard per line.

steps.caption: Type the addresses
steps.narration: Type the addresses, one per line.

steps.caption: Update
steps.narration: Choose Update. If a line isn't a valid address, nothing is saved and the line is named.

steps.caption: Whitelist IPs
steps.narration: Whitelist IPs are taken out of the list before it is served. This office address is already here.

steps.caption: Add your crew
steps.narration: Add your crew's addresses the same way.

steps.caption: List length
steps.narration: Exclusion list refresh rate is the length: how many IPs the list serves, from fifty to five hundred.

steps.caption: Set the length
steps.narration: Five hundred is Google's limit per campaign. Set a smaller number if you want.

steps.caption: Google Ads script
steps.narration: Under Google Ads script, IPs ready to sync counts what the list serves now.

steps.caption: Ready to sync
steps.narration: Your manual excludes come first, then blocked IPs, newest first, with the whitelist taken out.

steps.caption: Menu: Domain settings
steps.narration: These rules live under Domain settings, in Click Guard.

youtube.title: How to set your IP exclusion rules in Click Guard | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: How to shape the IP exclusion list in Click Guard in ConstructHUB. Under Domain settings you list the IPs you always want excluded, whitelist your office and crew so they are taken out, and set the list length from 50 up to Google's 500 per campaign.
